title: Bound on work-tape head displacement
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with $m$ work tapes and Boolean symbols, let $d$ be a configuration on input $x$, let $t\in\bbn$, and let $j<m$ be a work-tape index. The absolute displacement of the head of tape $j$ after $t$ steps from its position in $d$ is at most $t$.
hypotheses_covered: A machine with $m$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and state set $S$
